stem: The source notes that even a2-DOF closed-form torque equation is lengthy; why can the recursive method still be useful for a6-DOF robot?

options.text: It first requires every joint torque to be expanded into a closed-form symbolic expression before any numerical evaluation
It shortens the computation by treating each link as dynamically uncoupled from its neighbours
It avoids the long expressions by dropping velocity-product terms while retaining only acceleration and gravity terms
It evaluates linkwise motion and force recursions without requiring a fully expanded symbolic torque formula
